text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-9017 fired for synthetic-checks - canary-us-east-1 (5xx spike)

pagerduty-bot: PD-9017 created; routed to synth-oncall -> infra-oncall -> eng-sre escalation path

aj: ACKed PD-9017, I'm taking incident lead.

maria: seeing elevated 5xx from the us-east prober. 10-15% error rate on synthetic probes over last 4m. other regions normal. :frowning:

samir: any customer-facing errors?

aj: quick audit of edge error rates shows small fraction of customer requests routed via us-east with elevated errors — roughly 0.7% of overall traffic, but for a few Dedicated customers the observed error slice spikes to ~5% for short intervals. opening support ticket.

ops-runner-bot: retrieving probe logs from canary-us-east-1:
```
2026-03-14T07:42:11Z probe -> 502 upstream timeout runtime-host-7
2026-03-14T07:42:12Z probe -> 502 upstream timeout runtime-host-7
2026-03-14T07:42:30Z probe -> 200 runtime-host-1
```

aj: looks localized to runtime-host-7. kernel shows TCP retransmit bursts and RSTs to model-backend pool during the window. INF ticket coming.

maria: can we stop fanout temporarily to reduce noise and possible amplification?

aj: plan proposal:
  1) disable canary for us-east-1 to stop noisy alerts
  2) scale global prober concurrency to 30% for 5 minutes
  3) cordon runtime-host-7 and move workloads off it
  4) monitor customer-facing metrics and re-enable slowly if stable

samir: approved. execute.

aj: hitting internal prober control API to disable this region's canary:
```
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://internal-api.redwood/synth/probers/us-east-1/toggle" \
  -d '{"state":"disabled","reason":"PD-9017 mitigation"}'
```

ops-runner-bot: API resp 200 OK - canary us-east-1 set to DISABLED by aj at 2026-03-14T07:46:08Z

maria: reducing concurrency:
```
PATCH /synth/control HTTP/1.1
Host: internal-api.redwood
Content-Type: application/json
{"concurrency_scale":0.3, "duration_seconds":300}
```

ops-runner-bot: concurrency scaled from 1.0 -> 0.3; confirmed.

aj: cordoned runtime-host-7 from scheduler and draining pods. moving prober routing away. initiating infra ticket INF-902 assigned to bryan.

bryan: I'm on INF-902. initial telemetry shows NIC queue overflow and irq storms on runtime-host-7 around 07:42 UTC. scheduling reprovision and live-migrate workloads.

elaine: opened support ticket INC-3301 and notified CSMs for Dedicated customers that had brief elevated errors. draft blurb ready for review.

support-rep: proposed blurb: "Between 07:42–07:46 UTC we observed transient errors for requests routed through us-east-1 due to a degraded runtime host. We temporarily disabled the regional synthetic canary while we mitigated the host issue. Most traffic was routed via other regions; only a small percentage of requests experienced errors. We do not expect ongoing customer impact. A follow-up postmortem will be published."

samir: fine to send as “interim update” once PD notes updated.

aj: PD-9017 status: mitigation_in_progress. Adding notes and timeline.

ops-runner-bot: PD-9017 note appended: "canary disabled, runtime-host-7 cordoned, INF-902 filed"

maria: monitoring dashboard — synthetic 5xx for us-east down to ~0.1% after disable. customer edge errors trending to normal.

aj: infra is reprovisioning host; moving pods off completed. after host swap, plan to re-enable canary at low fanout (scale 0.1) and watch for 15m before full resume.

bryan: reprovision complete at 07:55 UTC. replaced NIC, kernel patches applied. will keep host out of rotation until validated.

aj: setting scheduled re-enable at 08:05 UTC with scale 0.1 then ramp to 0.5 after 10m if stable. handing off to maria for follow-through — I'm rotating off.

maria: taking orbit on this. I've picked up PD-9017. I will re-enable at 08:05 UTC and watch health panels, will escalate to eng-sre if any reoccurrence.

aj: handoff summary: PD-9017, INF-902, INC-3301. steps taken: regional canary disabled, prober concurrency scaled down, runtime-host-7 cordoned and reprovisioned. last elevated window 07:42-07:46 UTC.

maria: noted. posting timeline into PD and the incident tracker. will update channel after the 15m observation window post re-enable.

support-rep: sending interim customer notification now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-9017 marked mitigation_in_progress; owner -> maria

ops-runner-bot: PD-9017 handoff note: aj -> maria at 2026-03-14T07:56:00Z

maria: re-enable executed at 08:05 UTC with concurrency_scale 0.1.

ops-runner-bot: prober us-east-1 state -> ENABLED (scale 0.1).

maria: first 5m after re-enable looks nominal, 0.2% 5xx on probes, stable. ramping to scale 0.5 now.

ops-runner-bot: concurrency scale updated -> 0.5

maria: 15m observation complete. metrics steady, no regression to prior spike. closing PD-9017 as mitigated, leaving INF-902 for infra postmortem and INC-3301 for customer follow-up.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9017 status -> resolved (mitigated) by maria at 2026-03-14T08:25:12Z

post-incident follow-ups:
- infra to run hardware postmortem INF-902 (irq/NIC failure mode)
- update prober control to support graded fanout ramp and automatic region suppression when upstream reset counts exceed threshold
- export probe + edge traces for affected customers and attach to INC-3301
- consider alert tuning to suppress region-only noisy pages and send summary alerts instead

-- thread pinned: PD-9017, INF-902, INC-3301 --
